flags.why: The phrase means a new president and also applies after taking office, so “president-elect” incorrectly implies that inauguration is still pending ([usage](https://baochinhphu.vn/tan-tong-thong-han-quoc-yoon-suk-yeol-tuyen-the-nham-chuc-102220510115546933.htm)).
flags.fix: new president; newly elected or newly inaugurated president

flags.why: A tên hèm is a posthumous name used in ancestral prayers, rather than a dead person's name that is never spoken ([reference](https://www.namkyluctinh.org/a-vh-vminh/tvchi/tvchi-tangche.pdf)).
flags.fix: posthumous name used in ancestral rites

flags.why: “Tên lót” is primarily the Southern term for a middle name and needs a regional label ([reference](https://tenhay.vn/ten-dem-ten-lot-hay)).
